ai_summary: Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited reported a significant decline into net loss for Q2 and H1 FY27, primarily driven by a material exceptional expense of ₹19.9 Cr and a substantial 14-32% drop in MSW Processing revenue, sharply reversing prior year's profitability. While total operating revenue showed growth and operating cash flow remained positive, profitability margins eroded significantly, and liquidity weakened with cash balances halving and trade receivables rising, signaling potential financial and operational stress.
